derivation.centeredLog: Uniformly on the ENTIRE original closed interval0<=v<=L, q_i=partial_i log(w_plus) satisfies q_i_prime=M11_i+M12_i*r+M12*r_i, |q_i_prime-M11_i|<=B^264/S and |q_i_second_v|<=B^268/S; also |q_ij_prime|<=B^20. These polynomial bounds hold outside the Gaussian core too, so the tail coefficients are independent of B.
derivation.sourceDensity: Differentiate the ACTUAL centered density (w_plus(v)/w_plus(v0))^2 times the full frame and psi^2. The first density has 2*l_i; the second has4*l_i*l_j+2*l_ij, all frame derivatives and mixed products. No initial-center derivative is dropped.
derivation.gaussianMoments: The complete odd Gaussian moment is0 and integral x^2*exp(-x^2)=sqrt(pi)/2. Therefore Hbar_i/sqrt(gL) has radius2^-620 about0 and Hbar_ij/(gL) has radius2^-620 about2*mu_i*mu_j*Hbar. This is an enclosure with nonzero remainder.
derivation.tails: For n>=2, integral_M^infinity x^n*exp(-x^2/6) <= exp(-M^2/6)*[3*M^(n-1)+3*(n-1)*I_(n-2)], I0=3/M,I1=3. Both tails and all polynomials through degree4 are included. exp(-M^2/6)<2^-floor(M^2/6).
derivation.inverse: Differentiate Hbar*ybar=targetbar before the positive square root. The two first-product terms H_i*y_j and H_j*y_i are retained. Exact repeated/mixed sqrt differentiation then gives W_i/(A0*sqrt(gL))=0+error and W_ij/(A0*gL)=-mu_i*mu_j*(W/A0)+error.
derivation.conditioning: The first/second inverse and sqrt recurrences, |Hbar^-1|_infinity<=1, ybar in[1/8,1/2], sqrt(ybar)>=1/4 and |mu_i|<=2 give at most2^12 times the complete integral radius, less than2^-600.
